verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with API keys and scopes, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference, a try-it console or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. An API simply existing does not count as an explorable, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
